# LSTM: Temporal Progression Prediction

This notebook trains an attention-based LSTM using R `torch` to predict RANO
progression class from longitudinal region features.

```{r libraries}
library(torch)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(caret)

source("R/utils.R")
source("R/06_feature_extraction.R")
source("R/08_model_lstm.R")
source("R/09_clinical_validation.R")
```

## Step 1: Load Extracted Features

```{r load_features}
TABLES_PATH <- "results/tables"
MODEL_PATH <- "models/lstm_progression.pt"

ensure_dir("models")

region_table <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(TABLES_PATH, "all_regions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) {
    cat("Run the pipeline first (Rscript run.R --all) to generate feature tables.\n")
    tibble()
  }
)

event_table <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(TABLES_PATH, "all_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble()
)

long_features <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(TABLES_PATH, "longitudinal_features.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble()
)

patient_summaries <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(TABLES_PATH, "patient_summaries.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble()
)

cat("Regions:", nrow(region_table), "\n")
cat("Events:", nrow(event_table), "\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(patient_summaries), "\n")
```

## Step 2: Load RANO Labels

```{r rano}
clinical <- list()
csv_files <- list.files("data/raw/LUMIERE", pattern = "\\.csv$",
                         recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

for (f in csv_files) {
  df <- tryCatch(read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(df)) {
    rano_cols <- grep("rano|progression|disease", names(df),
                       value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
    if (length(rano_cols) > 0) {
      clinical$rano <- df
      cat("Found RANO data in:", basename(f), "\n")
      cat("Columns:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      break
    }
  }
}

# Create RANO labels dataframe — adapt column names to actual dataset
# This is a template; update column names after inspecting the CSV
if (!is.null(clinical$rano)) {
  rano_labels <- clinical$rano %>%
    select(patient_id = 1, rano_label = matches("rano|progression|disease")) %>%
    mutate(rano_label = case_when(
      grepl("progressive|PD", rano_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PD",
      grepl("stable|SD", rano_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SD",
      grepl("partial|PR", rano_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PR",
      grepl("complete|CR", rano_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "CR",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rano_label)) %>%
    distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  cat("RANO labels:", nrow(rano_labels), "\n")
  print(table(rano_labels$rano_label))
} else {
  cat("No RANO labels found. Cannot train LSTM.\n")
  rano_labels <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), rano_label = character(0))
}
```

## Step 3: Prepare Sequences

```{r prepare_sequences}
if (nrow(rano_labels) > 0 && nrow(region_table) > 0) {
  lstm_data <- prepare_lstm_features(
    patient_summaries, region_table, event_table,
    long_features, rano_labels, max_seq_len = 20L
  )

  cat("Prepared", lstm_data$n_patients, "patient sequences\n")
  cat("Input features:", length(lstm_data$feature_names), "\n")
  cat("Label distribution:\n")
  print(table(c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")[lstm_data$labels + 1]))
}
```

## Step 4: Train/Val Split

```{r split}
if (exists("lstm_data") && lstm_data$n_patients >= 10) {
  set.seed(42)
  n <- lstm_data$n_patients
  train_idx <- sample(n, floor(n * 0.8))
  val_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), train_idx)

  train_seq <- lstm_data$sequences[train_idx]
  train_lbl <- lstm_data$labels[train_idx]
  val_seq <- lstm_data$sequences[val_idx]
  val_lbl <- lstm_data$labels[val_idx]

  cat("Train:", length(train_seq), "| Val:", length(val_seq), "\n")
}
```

## Step 5: Train LSTM

```{r train, eval=FALSE}
# Set eval=TRUE when ready to train

input_size <- ncol(lstm_data$sequences[[1]])

result <- train_lstm(
  train_sequences = train_seq,
  train_labels = train_lbl,
  val_sequences = val_seq,
  val_labels = val_lbl,
  input_size = input_size,
  hidden_size = 64L,
  num_layers = 2L,
  n_classes = 4L,
  epochs = 100L,
  batch_size = 16L,
  lr = 1e-3,
  save_path = MODEL_PATH
)
```

## Step 6: Training Curves

```{r plot_curves, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
if (exists("result")) {
  p1 <- tibble(
    epoch = seq_along(result$history$train_loss),
    Train = result$history$train_loss,
    Val = result$history$val_loss
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(-epoch, names_to = "Split", values_to = "Loss") %>%
    ggplot(aes(epoch, Loss, color = Split)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Loss") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Train = "#2563eb", Val = "#dc2626")) +
    theme_minimal()

  p2 <- tibble(
    epoch = seq_along(result$history$train_acc),
    Train = result$history$train_acc * 100,
    Val = result$history$val_acc * 100
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(-epoch, names_to = "Split", values_to = "Accuracy") %>%
    ggplot(aes(epoch, Accuracy, color = Split)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Accuracy (%)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Train = "#2563eb", Val = "#dc2626")) +
    theme_minimal()

  p1 + p2
}
```

## Step 7: Evaluate on Validation Set

```{r evaluate}
if (file.exists(MODEL_PATH) && exists("val_seq")) {
  predictions <- predict_progression_lstm(MODEL_PATH, val_seq)

  pred_classes <- sapply(predictions, `[[`, "class")
  actual_classes <- c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")[val_lbl + 1]

  cat("Validation Results:\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", round(mean(pred_classes == actual_classes) * 100, 1), "%\n\n")

  metrics <- compute_classification_metrics(pred_classes, actual_classes)
  cat("Macro F1:", round(metrics$macro_f1, 3), "\n")
  cat("Weighted F1:", round(metrics$weighted_f1, 3), "\n\n")

  kappa <- compute_cohens_kappa(pred_classes, actual_classes)
  cat("Cohen's Kappa:", round(kappa$kappa, 3), "\n")
  cat("p-value:", format(kappa$p_value, scientific = TRUE), "\n\n")

  cat("Confusion Matrix:\n")
  print(metrics$confusion_matrix)

  cat("\nPer-class:\n")
  for (cls in names(metrics$per_class)) {
    pc <- metrics$per_class[[cls]]
    cat(sprintf("  %s: P=%.3f  R=%.3f  F1=%.3f\n",
                cls, pc$precision, pc$recall, pc$f1))
  }
}
```

## Step 8: Ablation Study — LSTM vs Rule-Based

```{r ablation, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(patient_summaries) > 0 && nrow(rano_labels) > 0) {
  rule_ablation <- run_ablation_study(patient_summaries, rano_labels)
  print_validation_report(rule_ablation)

  # Ablation comparison plot
  abl_table <- format_ablation_table(rule_ablation)

  abl_plot <- abl_table %>%
    mutate(across(c(`Macro F1`, Kappa, `PD Sensitivity`, `PD F1`),
                  ~as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(`Macro F1`, Kappa, `PD Sensitivity`, `PD F1`),
                 names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(Approach, Value, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Ablation Study: Approach Comparison",
         y = "Score") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

  print(abl_plot)
  ggsave("results/figures/ablation_comparison.png", abl_plot,
         width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 150)
}
```
